meaning:
απο-μάσσω
(μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: Tob.7:17 * ;]
to wipe off, wire clean: mid., Luk.10:11.†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: we wipe off as a testimony

elsewhere.note: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
